description:
Outcome: Owner can inspect understandable phone journeys (brief.md: Users, Constraints).
Scope: Synthetic prototypes for emailed login, application preferences, pending/waitlisted/allocated status, coordinator grid and reports. Excludes: production persistence.
Acceptance: Phone and desktop views include large text, readable controls, full garden, no allocation and error examples.
Behaviour: Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Keyboard/phone walkthrough and screen inventory. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: schematic grid until actual plot labels/layout supplied.
title: Create mobile journey prototype
